rotation: Inflation and monetary policy uncertainty suggest a preference for sectors with pricing power, such as energy and materials. Geopolitical instability and commodity price volatility pressure sectors reliant on global trade, like basic materials and industrials. Rising national debt and labor market stabilization favor defensive sectors like healthcare and consumer staples. AI investment and productivity concerns could support tech and software sectors, while erosion of trust may impact financials and real estate.
